title: Existing native proper projection-coincidence square
statement: Let C be a Grothendieck abelian symmetric monoidal closed coefficient category admitting functorial flat resolutions and inverse image preserving flat objects. Equip C with a concrete structure whose forgetful functor reflects isomorphisms, preserves filtered colimits in the required universe and admits composition with sheaves on every small etale site. Let f:X to Y be proper, K an arbitrary unbounded C-valued etale complex on X, and L such a complex on Y. Write T for derived tensor, U for derived inverse image, F! for the chosen-compactification direct image with compact support, F* for ordinary derived direct image, c:F! isomorphic to F* for canonical proper coincidence, and p!,p* for the two projection maps constructed from adjunction counits and extension by zero. Then p!(K,L) followed by c at T(K,U L) equals T(c at K,1 at L) followed by p*(K,L). This is the existing, fully proved native source lemma, not the later complete six-functor coherence package. Every operation and map in this statement is its native constructed map.

proof.text: For the chosen compactification c of f, expand the canonical proper comparison. Its hom is the direct-image composition comparison after the forget-supports map. The explicit equations rightDerivedLowerShriekIsoRightDerivedLowerStar_hom and rightDerivedLowerShriekToLowerStarComp_comp_eq identify it with compactificationForgetSupports at c.

The compactification projection is the composite proper direct-image projection and the open-immersion tensor comparison. The latter intertwines extension by zero with ordinary direct image. Apply the elementary composition law for counit projection maps to the two inverse-image/direct-image adjunctions of c.i and c.g and their composite f. The open-factor equality is derivedOpenImmersionLowerShriekProjectionIso_inv_comp_toLowerStar; the ordinary composite equality is rightDerivedLowerStarProjectionMap_comp with the canonical pullback composition comparison. Naturality and associativity give the forget-supports projection square. Substitute the identification of step 1. These are the complete existing source proofs in LowerShriekProjectionProper.lean:103-118 and ProjectionFormulaCoherence.lean:111-125; they use no projective-line adjunction.

theorem projectionMap_comp_rightDerivedLowerShriekIsoRightDerivedLowerStar (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsProper f] (K : _root_.DerivedCategory (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology A))
    (L : _root_.DerivedCategory (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology A)) :
    ((projectionMap A f).app K).app L ≫
        (rightDerivedLowerShriekIsoRightDerivedLowerStar A f).hom.app
          (((-⊗ᴸ-(X)[A]).obj K).obj (L((f)^*[A]).obj L)) =
      ((-⊗ᴸ-(Y)[A]).map ((rightDerivedLowerShriekIsoRightDerivedLowerStar A f).hom.app K)).app L ≫
        ((rightDerivedLowerStarProjectionMap A f).app K).app L
